_doc: Closed vocabularies for two open fields on atom labels (items 24 and 25).
entity_tags: the prefixes an entity key (`prefix:value`) may use, one spelling per thing (labeling rule 50).
A prefix with `values` is closed on its values too; every other prefix takes any slug as its value.
prefix_aliases, key_aliases and pattern_aliases each map one old spelling to exactly one canonical spelling; only these are ever renamed.
review_aliases are near-duplicates whose rename needs a person (the mapping is not one-to-one): counted and proposed, never applied.
scope_category: the company-layer SOW group a line is filed under (conduct.routing). `aliases` maps a retired spelling to its value.
Off-list values are kept and counted, never dropped (app/core/label_vocab.py, app/learning/human_labels.py, scripts/label_vocab_dryrun.py).

party.desc: An organization in the deal: customer, reseller, provider or subcontractor. Never org: or customer:.

stakeholder.desc: A named person in a role on the deal, first_last with the short first name as written in the header.

role.desc: A job role (project_manager, technician), not a name.

platform.desc: A software platform the work runs on.

system.desc: A customer system the work touches.

service.desc: A kind of service delivered; on_site, never onsite.

scope.desc: A kind of scope a line covers or leaves out.

site.desc: A place where the work happens, <city_st> or a named site.

part_number.desc: A part number or SKU, in its own spelling (never respelled).

qty.desc: A stated quantity, <n> or <n>_<unit> (qty:6_sites, qty:208_days). Never quantity:.

money.desc: A stated amount of money. Never amount:.

billing.desc: The billing basis a line states.

values.fixed: A fixed price for the work.
values.t_and_m: Time and materials: billed by the hour or day worked.

sla.desc: A service level (sla:none when the line says there is none).

term.desc: A commercial term not covered by billing:, rate: or sla:.

option.desc: A numbered option in a quote.

delivery.desc: How the work is delivered (delivery:on_site, delivery:remote).

action_item.desc: An action item and its owner.

artifact.desc: A kind of document the deal refers to (artifact:sla).

doc.desc: The source document or its version (doc:sow_v2).

section.desc: A SOW section slug, the section's full heading.

values.project_fundamentals: The SOW's opening facts: the parties, the version, the dates and the contacts.
values.project_scope: The overall scope statement: what the engagement covers.
values.service_model: How the service is delivered: on site or remote, staffing and the working model.
values.visit_cadence: The schedule of on-site visits and how long each lasts.
values.service_level: Response times, coverage hours and service levels.
values.coordination: Coordination with the customer's teams or third parties.
values.customer_designated_locations: The list of sites the customer designates.
values.items_provided: What the provider supplies (tools, equipment, materials).
values.customer_responsibilities: What the customer must do or provide.
values.project_assumptions: The assumptions the SOW rests on.
values.project_scheduling: Scheduling, start dates and lead times.
values.services_fees: The fee table: rates, units and estimated billable units.
